prompts: Write a Python function that merges overlapping time intervals given as pairs of start and end minutes. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Rust function that parses a comma separated line into fields while respecting quoted commas. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a TypeScript function that debounces an async callback and cancels the pending call when a new one arrives. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Go function that counts word frequencies in a large text file using a fixed amount of memory. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a C function that reverses the words of a sentence in place without allocating a new buffer. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Python function that validates a sudoku board and reports the first row, column or box that breaks the rules. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Rust function that implements a ring buffer with push, pop and an iterator over the stored values. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Java function that finds the shortest path in a grid with walls using breadth first search. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a Python function that computes a running median of a stream of integers with two heaps. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

Write a SQL function that returns the three most recent orders for every customer in an orders table. Explain the time and memory complexity, describe the edge cases you handle, and give two short examples of the output.

A data analyst has a table of monthly electricity use for two hundred households. Describe step by step how to test whether a new tariff reduced consumption, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of daily temperatures from three weather stations over ten years. Describe step by step how to estimate the warming trend at each station, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of exam scores from four schools with different class sizes. Describe step by step how to compare the schools fairly, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of website visits and purchases split by device type. Describe step by step how to decide whether the mobile checkout performs worse, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of hospital waiting times recorded every hour for a year. Describe step by step how to find the busiest periods and their causes, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of delivery times for a courier company in five cities. Describe step by step how to check whether one city is consistently slower, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of sensor readings from a factory machine sampled every second. Describe step by step how to detect drift before the machine fails, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of survey answers about commuting habits from two thousand workers. Describe step by step how to summarise the main patterns, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of sales of ice cream and umbrellas across a whole summer. Describe step by step how to explain why the two series are correlated, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.

A data analyst has a table of response times of a web service before and after a code change. Describe step by step how to decide whether the change helped, which summary statistics to report, and what could make the conclusion misleading.
